summary: Chemomab Therapeutics Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting board and committee changes effective June 1, 2026. Two directors, Claude Nicaise and Jill Quigley, resigned from the board and audit committee effective May 29, 2026; neither resignation stemmed from a disagreement. Gwen Melincoff was appointed as a Class I director and chair of the nominating and governance committee. Neil Cohen and Nissim Darvish joined the audit committee, and Cohen resigned as nominating committee chair. Board size is now five. These changes are routine directorial adjustments with no disclosed compensation or advisor. Watch for any subsequent strategic shifts given the new board composition.
